title: They’re scanning the skies…
paragraphs:
They’re scanning the skies…
waiting for something to come down.

But what if…
Someone already did?

We keep asking, “Are we alone?”
Building telescopes.
Chasing signals.
Hoping the silence breaks.
But the Bible doesn’t point us to distant planets.
It points us to a hill.
“In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.” — Genesis 1:1

Every star you’ve ever seen…
every galaxy science is still trying to name…
every mystery beyond human reach—
So yes, God could create life anywhere.
But here’s the truth we keep missing:

The Bible is not silent about life.
It’s laser-focused on YOUR life.
Because something went terribly wrong on this planet.

Not as a theory…
but as a fracture in the human soul.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23

That includes me.
That includes you.
And here’s where the story flips.

Because while we were looking up…
God chose to come down.
“And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us…” — John 1:14

Not a signal.
Not a spacecraft.
Not a distant observer.
Jesus Christ stepped into dust, sweat, blood, and pain.

He was betrayed.
Mocked.
Beaten.
Crucified.

Real nails.
Real blood.
Real agony.
“Surely He has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows… He was pierced for our transgressions.” — Isaiah 53:4-5

We want mysteries in the sky
while ignoring the miracle on the ground.

We chase the unknown
while rejecting what’s already revealed.
“But God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8

Not when you were perfect.
Not when you had it together.
“He is not here, for He has risen, as He said.” — Matthew 28:6
This is the turning point of eternity.
Hope stepped out of a tomb.
So whether aliens exist or not…
It changes nothing about your eternity.
You’re not waiting for something to visit Earth.
“Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out.” — Acts 3:19

Turning from sin.
Trusting in Christ.
Receiving grace you didn’t earn.
“For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life.” — John 3:16
The God of the universe stepped into your story…
So you could step into His eternity.
“We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.”
